sources.title: ISO/IEC 82304-2 — health software quality & safety
sources.why: Defines independent app-assessment and the voluntary quality-label conformity route that non-device health apps can be audited and certified against.

sources.title: SaMD lifecycle standards (IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 62366-1, ISO 13485)
sources.why: These standards build the audit-ready technical file and ISO 13485 QMS that notified bodies certify and audit for medical-device software.
